_README: Provenance for researched hardware specs. Build/authoring input ONLY - never imported by src/, so it never reaches the browser. Same rule as data/benchmarks/. Keyed part id -> spec key -> {url, checkedOn} for a verified figure, or {checkedOn, result: 'unverifiable', note} when the figure is not published anywhere and the field has been DELETED from partsData.json.

memType.note: ⚠️ length and slotsThick are deliberately NOT sourced for this card. On that same AMD table the Length and Slots columns are EMPTY for the RX 5700 - AMD publishes neither - and TechPowerUp has no reachable database entry for it. The field keeps its existing 254 mm rather than being deleted: an absent length makes the public part page render 'undefined mm long, so it fits 0 of 59 cases'.

length.note: TechPowerUp's review of the AMD REFERENCE card: "Dimensions of the card are 27.0 x 11.0 cm." Supersedes an unverifiable record — AMD leaves Length blank on its own table, but the reference card was measured in review. The catalogue's old 254 mm was 16 mm short.

pcieGen.note: Same review: "The chip features a PCI-Express 4.0 x16 bus interface." AMD publishes no PCIe generation for any card.

length.note: The RX 7650 GRE is a China-exclusive SKU with no page on AMD's global site, but AMD's Chinese site carries the full specification: 尺寸 长度 204 mm, 插槽 2. The catalogue's 232 mm was 28 mm too long. Secondary aggregators disagreed with each other on this card, which is why the manufacturer page was worth finding.

tdp.note: 典型板载功耗（台式机）170 W. The catalogue said 165 W - the figure several aggregators quote - but AMD's own page says 170 W.
